title: NBA 2K27 Names Wembanyama, Caitlin Clark, and Derrick Rose as Cover Athletes
excerpt: 2K's latest basketball game launches September 4 with three editions, each headlined by a different star. Caitlin Clark becomes the first WNBA player featured on her own global NBA 2K cover.
body:
• Victor Wembanyama covers the Standard Edition ($69.99), Caitlin Clark the Deluxe Edition ($99.99), and Derrick Rose the limited Ultra Edition ($149.99) of NBA 2K27.
  • Clark is the first WNBA player to appear on her own global NBA 2K premium cover, a milestone for women's basketball visibility.
  • The game launches September 4, 2026 on PS5, Xbox Series X|S, PC, and Nintendo Switch 2, with early access on August 28 for Deluxe and Ultra Edition buyers.
  • Rose returns to the franchise's box art for the first time since NBA 2K13, months after the Chicago Bulls retired his No. 1 jersey.

2K on Wednesday revealed the three cover athletes for NBA 2K27, pairing the NBA's most dominant young force with a WNBA trailblazer and a beloved league veteran. San Antonio Spurs center Victor Wembanyama will front the Standard Edition, Indiana Fever guard Caitlin Clark will headline the Deluxe Edition, and former Chicago Bulls MVP Derrick Rose will appear on the limited-time Ultra Edition.

The game, developed by Visual Concepts and published by 2K, a label of Take-Two Interactive (NASDAQ: TTWO), launches globally on September 4 across PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, PC via Steam, and Nintendo Switch 2. Buyers of the Deluxe or Ultra editions gain early access starting August 28 at 9:00 AM PDT.

Wembanyama's Breakout Earns Top Billing

Wembanyama, 22, becomes the first Spurs player to grace an NBA 2K cover. The French center made history this past season as the league's first-ever unanimous Defensive Player of the Year, collecting all 100 first-place votes. He also earned a First Team All-NBA selection and Western Conference Finals MVP honors while leading San Antonio back to the NBA Finals for the first time since 2014, where the Spurs fell to the New York Knicks.

https://youtube.com/watch?v=GkeSV0Jko9Y

"NBA 2K is the court that never locks up, it's always open whether you're in Paris or San Antonio. It's how you study the game, sharpen your IQ, and live basketball 24/7."

— Victor Wembanyama, San Antonio Spurs

Clark Makes WNBA History on the Cover

Clark's Deluxe Edition cover marks the first time a WNBA player has headlined her own global NBA 2K premium edition. The 24-year-old guard, now in her third professional season, is averaging a career-high 20.7 points per game and 7.8 assists — second-best in the WNBA — after an injury-plagued 2025 campaign limited her to just 13 games. A three-time All-Star starter and the 2024 Kia WNBA Rookie of the Year, Clark has been credited with transforming the commercial landscape of women's basketball.

She follows a growing line of WNBA players who have appeared on NBA 2K covers, including Candace Parker in 2022, Diana Taurasi and Sue Bird in 2023, Sabrina Ionescu in 2024, A'ja Wilson in 2025, and Angel Reese in 2026. Clark's edition, however, is the first to give a women's basketball player standalone global billing rather than a shared or regional cover.

"To be the first WNBA player on her own global cover means women's basketball gets to show up on that stage too, and I am proud to be part of that."

— Caitlin Clark, Indiana Fever

Rose Returns to the Cover After 14 Years

Rose, who last appeared on the box art for NBA 2K13, returns to headline the Ultra Edition at $149.99. The three-time All-Star and youngest MVP in NBA history has experienced one of the sport's most storied comeback arcs, battling through multiple knee injuries to extend a 16-year career. Earlier this year, the Bulls retired his No. 1 jersey, placing him alongside Michael Jordan, Scottie Pippen, Jerry Sloan, and Bob Love as the only players so honored by the franchise.

The Ultra Edition, available through September 6, bundles everything in the Deluxe Edition plus additional in-game currency, a Season 1 Pro Pass, premium MyTEAM player cards, and exclusive cosmetic items.

Editions, Pricing, and What's Next

The Standard Edition retails at $69.99 and launches on all four platforms. The Deluxe Edition at $99.99 includes 100,000 VC, MyCAREER boosts and jerseys, and MyTEAM content, plus the week-early access window. The Ultra Edition adds further premium perks at $149.99. NBA 2K26 players who pre-order the Ultra Edition on the same platform receive a 10 percent loyalty discount.

2K said the official NBA 2K27 gameplay trailer will drop on July 28. Pre-orders are live now on the NBA 2K27 website and through platform storefronts.

Zak Armitage, SVP and GM of NBA 2K, framed the trio as embodiments of the franchise's identity. "None of them have an off switch, and that same relentless drive is what defines NBA 2K27," Armitage said in the announcement.

The game is rated E for Everyone by the ESRB.
image_caption: Victor Wembanyama during a San Antonio Spurs game in 2024. The 22-year-old French center was named the Standard Edition cover athlete for NBA 2K27.
nri_angle: NBA 2K is one of the world's best-selling sports franchises with a massive global player base, including growing basketball fandom among the Indian diaspora. The game's expansion to Nintendo Switch 2 and continued WNBA integration broadens its reach.
